core_obligations: Reduce regularity to the regular local rings (proof lines 10414-10416).
Reduce flatness to the induced maps of local rings (proof lines 10416-10418).
Conclude that the three conditions coincide (proof lines 10418-10419).
difficulty_reason: The lemma records that regularity of a ring map into a Noetherian ring can be checked at all pairs of primes lying over one another, or equivalently at maximal ideals of the target lying over maximal ideals of the source. The statement carries a title naming it as a local property. The proof reduces both conditions to their local counterparts: a Noetherian ring is regular exactly when all its local rings are regular, and a ring map is flat exactly when all induced maps of local rings are flat, so the global conditions and the local ones are the same.
